mechanism: Estradiol may increase ketorolac concentrations via CYP3A4 and CYP2C inhibition, while NSAIDs can reduce estradiol efficacy and increase thrombotic risk in hormonal contraceptive users.
action: Monitor for NSAID efficacy and bleeding/clotting signs; consider alternative analgesics if estradiol is used for contraception or HRT; counsel on increased VTE risk.
